- The `@returns` section is not necessary for a simple module like this. Instead, focus on the purpose and usage.

Revised Docstring:
```typescript
/**
 * Provides a root layout for the application, wrapping the main content with various context providers to manage wallet state, transaction history, NFT store, and my listings.
 * This ensures that these components are available throughout the application, enhancing the user experience by providing consistent access to critical functionalities.
 *
 * @returns The application's main content, properly wrapped with context providers.
 */
export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode
}>) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <body className="font-sans antialiased bg-background">
        <WalletProvider>
          <TxToastProvider>
            <TxHistoryProvider>
              <NFTStoreProvider>
                <MyListingsProvider>
                  {children}
                  <Analytics />
                </MyListingsProvider>
              </NFTStoreProvider>
            </TxHistoryProvider>
          </TxToastProvider>
        </WalletProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}

/**
 * Metadata for the application, including the title, description, and generator information.
 */
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'NFTerra',
  description: 'Evolve your digital assets with NFTerra. Dynamic NFTs that level up and transform on the blockchain.',
  generator: 'v0.app',
  icons: {
    // Use custom icon from public/111.jpg for all platforms
    icon: '/111.jpg',
    apple: '/111.jpg',
  },
}
```
